g.text: Isolates retrieval, ranking, generation, and abstention root causes without external LLM judges.
— Running 5 bundled synthetic benchmark failure cases
Generation Failure Suspected (Retrieved context had high relevance, but the
generated answer appears ungrounded or contradicted context)
"What is the mandatory response time for a P1 incident?"
"The incident response time for P1 incidents is 24 hours."

• Context was directly supplied in top-k prompt window, but answer failed or contradicts

Ranking Failure Suspected (Candidate pool contained evidence, but top-k

"How should database connection timeouts be configured during failover?"
"Database timeouts default to 60 seconds across all services."
• Auto-calibrated thresholds to score distribution (auto-calibrated (high-shift, mean=0.71,
• Candidate retrieval pool contained 4 chunks, truncated to top-2.

• Root cause (suspected): Candidate retrieval succeeded, but ranking omitted evidence.
Trace-only mode cannot verify if unretrieved documents exist in

Unknown (Telemetry is borderline, conflicting, or insufficient to isolate root
"What is the maximum retention window for audit logs in the EU cluster?"
"Audit logs are retained for 90 days before archive."
• Trace-only mode: Without access to the corpus index, cannot determine whether retriever
missed documents or question is unanswerable.
Candidate pool prior to top-k truncation was not logged in trace.
Provide corpus index (--corpus) or reference answer, or verify telemetry
Generation Failure Proven (Reference evidence was present in context, but
generator failed to produce expected answer)
"What is the statutory deadline for submitting quarterly security reviews?"
"Quarterly security reviews must be submitted within 45 days of quarter end."
• Retrieved context chunk 'chunk_security_review' in top-1 contains the reference answer.
• Generated answer 'Quarterly security reviews must be submitted within 45 days of quarter
end.' failed to match expected answer '10 business days'.
• Root cause: Context was present in the prompt, but generator failed to incorporate it.
lexical + semantic fallback); complex multi-hop reasoning or external factual drift is not
